description: Defines a custom sealed class CalculatorButton inheriting from Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.Button, with dependency properties for button ID, auditory feedback, and visual styles, including event handling for key presses and property changes.

classes.name: CalculatorButton
classes.description: A custom button control with additional properties for calculator functionality and styling.

methods.name: CalculatorButton
methods.description: Constructor that sets default command binding for the button.

methods.description: Handles changes to the ButtonId property, updating command parameters.

methods.name: OnAuditoryFeedbackPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the AuditoryFeedback property, updating command parameters.

methods.name: OnKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key down event to ignore Enter key presses.
